title: internal/runstate maintenance fixture control fails on this host's git
body: TestTheStoresFetchStartsNoMaintenanceInTheRepositoryItWritesTo dies at its control step: 'a plain `git fetch` in the armed repository started no maintenance; this fixture proves nothing', despite the test arming maintenance.loose-objects.auto=-1. Reproduced identically at base commit f4f5cac334c2, so it is not this tick's change; the fixture is sensitive to the host git's maintenance behavior (the test's own comment says CI needed git 2.55-era geometric repack). The full Go suite cannot pass on this host until the fixture arms maintenance in a way that holds across git versions, or skips when the control fails.
